Every file that literally references the `PlanId` type (via `import type { PlanId }`, a `: PlanId` annotation, `PlanId` as a type argument, or as a `Record<PlanId, …>` key) needs to be opened when a new plan is added. I excluded:

- `scripts/manifest-parts/domain.ts` and `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts` — they only contain the substring `"PlanId"` inside plain string literals (manifest documentation text), not actual TypeScript type syntax.
- `src/schemas/feature-flag.ts`, `src/schemas/organization.ts`, `tests/schemas/billing.schema.test.ts` — these use the separately-defined `planIdSchema` Zod value, never the `PlanId` type itself.
- `tests/config/plan-limits.test.ts` — only consumes the `PLAN_IDS` value array, never names the `PlanId` type.
